title: CaiRL: A High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Environment Toolkit
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It benchmarks the execution speed, training time, and carbon footprint of a reinforcement learning software toolkit.
findings: This paper has no findings related to religion. Its key finding is that the proposed CaiRL toolkit is significantly faster and more energy-efficient than the OpenAI Gym toolkit for running reinforcement learning experiments.
